If you don’t mind, that would really help. Does that mean you’ll be staying at my place tonight? Do you need to pop home first to grab your things? I can’t wait to see you again.

From: Morgan, Claire  
Sent: Monday, 29 October 2024 09:28  
To: Bennett, James  
Subject:  

I’m really looking forward to seeing you this evening. If you have a lot to sort out at home, I’m happy to come to your place after the Eastbrook Conference. I have a Halcyon Mutual 2024 Planning Review from 2:30 to 4:30, so I won’t be at your team meeting. I should be free until then.

Love,

Claire
